explain.ja: 矢倉棒銀の基本図は図1-1のとおりです。まずこの陣形をどう組むかを見ていきます。
explain.en: Figure 1-1 is the basic diagram of Yagura Climbing Silver. First see how to build this formation.

section.en: Basic form of Yagura Climbing Silver

explain.ja: まず「矢倉囲い」に組みます。玉を左側に持っていき、金銀3枚で守りの形を作ります。
explain.en: First build a Yagura castle: move the king to the left side and form the defence with three gold/silver pieces.

explain.ja: 飛車先の歩を突き、銀を前に出して「棒銀」の形に組みます。飛車・銀・歩を縦一列に並べる攻撃的な陣形です。飛車と銀で攻めるので形も分かりやすいです。
explain.en: Push the rook pawn and advance the silver to form Bogin (Climbing Silver). It is an aggressive formation lining up rook, silver and pawn on one file. It attacks with rook and silver, so its shape is easy to understand.

section.en: Make the attacking shape Rushing Silver

explain.ja: 図2-1は、初手から▲7六歩、△3四歩、▲6六歩と進んだ局面です。先手はこのように角道を閉じてから矢倉囲いに組みます。角交換の将棋は複雑になりやすく初心者は苦手にしがちですが、矢倉なら角道を閉じて角交換を避けた駒組みができます。
explain.en: Figure 2-1 is the position after ▲7六歩, △3四歩, ▲6六歩. Black closes the bishop's diagonal and then builds a Yagura castle. Bishop exchange games easily become complicated and many beginners dislike them, but in Yagura you can close the diagonal and avoid the exchange.

section.en: The bishop exchange can be avoided

title.en: Figure 2-2: Aim for a silver exchange

explain.ja: 矢倉棒銀のもう一つの利点は、攻めの狙いが分かりやすいことです。棒銀は▲9五銀と銀を五段目に進出させ、そこから▲2四歩と攻めます。図2-2からは、△同歩、▲同銀、△同銀、▲同飛と進みます。銀を持ち駒にすることで様々な攻め筋が生まれます。相手の守りの銀と自分の攻めの銀を交換し、攻め駒は盤上より持ち駒のほうが好きな所に使えて価値が高くなります。
explain.en: Another merit of Yagura Climbing Silver is that the aim of the attack is clear. Climbing Silver advances the silver to the fifth rank with ▲9五銀 and attacks with ▲2四歩. From Figure 2-2, play goes △同歩, ▲同銀, △同銀, ▲同飛. Having a silver in hand opens various attacks. You trade your attacking silver for the opponent's defending silver, and an attacking piece in hand is worth more than one on the board since it can be used anywhere.

section.ja: 攻めの狙いがわかりやすい
section.en: The aim of the attack is easy to see
